title: Minions
summary: Minions work a block for you while you're away and keep half the skill XP for you.

s.x: works one block for you: every 30 seconds it mines its ore, chops its log or harvests its crop, and keeps the drops and
until you collect them. It keeps working while you are away or offline (the server only has to be running) and holds up to
of work (240 actions). After that it stops and puffs angry clouds until you empty it.
(Minions tab): 2 Iron Blocks, 32 Redstone, 16 Copper Ingots and 8 Amethyst Shards. No skill level is needed.
one minion, plus one more per 10 levels of your best skill
Place it anywhere in the survival world.

Right-click it with the block it should work: an ore (Iron Ore, Diamond Ore...), a log, or seeds for a crop (Wheat Seeds, a Carrot, a Potato...). Anything that gives skill XP when you break it works. It shows little puffs of that block while it works.
Right-click it with an empty hand (or anything else) to collect: the items go into your inventory (or drop at your feet if it's full) and you get the XP. Chat shows what it made.
Right-click it with a different block to change its work; it hands over what it made first.
Only the owner can collect from a minion or break it. Breaking it collects everything first and gives the Minion back.

rows.x: one action every 30 seconds (120 an hour)
half of what breaking the block yourself gives; Insight does not boost it
the block's normal drops, without Fortune

s.x: An Iron Ore minion makes about 120 Raw Iron and 300 Mining XP an hour.
